Additionally, some sprinkles on the yellow donut appear to float slightly without proper shadow contact or integration with the glaze (severity ~1.0). The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions (noise, blur, compression), which aligns with the clean appearance. The authenticity penalty should reflect the structural/mat issue but not be overly harsh given the otherwise strong rendering.
